title: 1975 São Toméan parliamentary election
text: Parliamentary elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 7 and 8 July 1975. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Movement for the Liberation of São Tomé and Príncipe (MLSTP) as the sole legal party. A total of 52 candidates contested the election, almost all of whom had been nominated by the MLSTP. Around 21,000 people were registered to vote.
